ruled_out_vectors.vector: C13: PoolDecoder max-value edge cases — max pool type, max fee, all-bits-set poolId
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Forge fuzz + unit tests confirm PoolDecoder.getPoolType and getPoolFee round-trip correctly for all inputs. With 6 leading zero bytes enforced by POOL_TYPE_ADDRESS_MASK, the 112-bit address fits cleanly in the poolId upper bits. All-bits-set poolId extracts correctly. Fuzz tested with 25 random (address, uint16) pairs — all pass. Pool type with only 5 leading zero bytes correctly fails the mask check (uint160 & POOL_TYPE_ADDRESS_MASK != 0).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C14: createPool edge parameters — zero fee, max fee (10000 BPS), DYNAMIC_POOL_FEE_BPS, invalid pool type
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Code analysis + Forge unit tests confirm: (1) fee > MAX_BPS && fee != DYNAMIC_POOL_FEE_BPS reverts LBAMM__PoolFeeMustBeLessThan100Percent. (2) fee == 10000 (100%) passes. (3) fee == 55555 requires poolHook != address(0). (4) Pool type without 6 leading zero bytes reverts LBAMM__InvalidPoolType. (5) Identical tokens revert LBAMM__CannotPairIdenticalTokens. (6) Token ordering auto-corrected (token0 > token1 swapped). (7) Pool ID validated: Core checks getPoolType(poolId) == details.poolType && getPoolFee(poolId) == details.fee.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C16: _validatePricingBounds all-paths enforcement — Halmos symbolic verification
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Halmos symbolic execution verified 2 of 3 checks: (1) check_pricingBoundsAlwaysEnforced — PASS, 21 paths, 0.05s. Confirms: when bounds.isSet=true and price is valid, all code paths enforce min/max constraints. For direct swaps (poolType==address(0)), both min and max are always enforced. For pool-type swaps, directional tolerance applies (zeroForOne allows temp above-max, !zeroForOne allows temp below-min). (2) check_zeroPriceAlwaysReverts — PASS, 29 paths. Confirms: when computeRatioX96 returns 0, the explicit zero check at line 847-850 catches it. Without this check, 0 > maxBound would be false, allowing bypass. (3) check_computeRatioX96_bounded — TIMEOUT (assembly complexity exceeds solver). The bounded check for normal inputs was already verified by the previous agent's fuzz tests.

(2) incorrect-return for delegateCallPure — false positive, intentional diamond proxy pattern using assembly return. (3) reentrancy-balance in _distributeAndCollectLiquidityTokens and _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse — false positive, reentrancy guard flags (SWAP_GUARD_FLAG, LIQUIDITY_GUARD_FLAG) prevent re-entry, and balance checks (line 2208) ensure conservation. (4) uninitialized-local (12 instances) — false positive, all are struct variables initialized to Solidity default (zero), which is the intended initial state. No exploitable findings.
